thread:
Nora: quick FYI — preview for the runtime runbook intermittently 502s and i traced one failing link to a shortlink that resolves to a presigned URL that now 403s. repro:

Nora: curl -I https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/kb/runtime/kv-cache | sed -n '1,20p'
---
HTTP/2 302
location: /s/short/zz9x

HTTP/2 403
content-type: text/html
---

Diego: thanks for the trace. if it's 403 that probably means the presign expired or the S3 object has restricted access. do you have the original shortlink markdown?

Nora: it's `More on caching: [kv cache notes](/s/short/zz9x)` in the runtime guide.

Maya: tagging a quick remediation plan: 1) replace shortlink with canonical absolute path in the md so preview isn't flaky, 2) add an entry in redirects.yaml to map the shortlink to the canonical URL for existing inbound links, 3) eng-platform to investigate why the shortlink resolver sometimes returns expired presigned URLs.

Diego: i'll open a tiny PR for step (1) and (2). will grep to find other uses: `git grep -n "zz9x" || true` and include locales if present.

docs-bot: CI pipeline queued for merge request 4892 (branch: fix/replace-zz9x) — status: pending. preview will be available when staging deploy runs.

Maya: quick note on locales: if we add redirects.yaml entry please flag intl owners in the PR so translations can be reviewed. otherwise translated pages may still reference the old shortlink and get 403s for users.

Diego: PR created https://git.internal.redwood.ai/docs/merge_requests/4892 — title: "fix: replace expired shortlink zz9x + redirect mapping". changed files include: docs/runtime/kv-cache.md, redirects.yaml, locales/ja/runtime/kv-cache.md (updated link). cc @Maya for intl owners.

eng-platform: can you please look at resolver logs for shortlink id zz9x? curious whether presign generation is happening with too-short TTL or if S3 permissions changed. filing internal ticket ENGPLAT-1223.

docs-bot: staging preview ready -> https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/8b9c0d (screenshots attached)

Nora: preview looks green for me, replaced link lands on canonical anchor and no 502/403. thanks Diego + Maya. i'll note ENGPLAT-1223 in the runbook entry and add a follow-up to verify other shortlinks.

Diego: merged after CI green. left PR note for locale owners to confirm.

eng-platform: quick update — saw a pattern where presign TTL in the resolver defaulted to 30s for certain async preview flows; raised a config change to 15m and will monitor. will post updates in ENGPLAT-1223.

Nora: excellent. closing this micro-incident. if anyone sees another shortlink flap ping #eng-platform and drop the shortlink id. :tada:
